responsibility: Implements Linux host hooks for precompiled-header address selection and loading under Linux virtual-memory behavior. It chooses architecture-specific candidate address regions, probes them with mmap, detects address-space randomization settings from /proc, uses a temporary buffer-allocation heuristic to improve address stability when ASLR-like randomization is enabled, and loads the PCH either by direct file mapping or by anonymous mapping plus copying when fixed private mappings fail. This is Linux host runtime support for GCC PCH, not Linux target semantics.
